scope: Actual point doubling is surjective for every nonsingular general Weierstrass model over every algebraically closed field, all characteristics, derived from actual quartic coordinate fibers, actual curve fibers, denominator nonvanishing and actual negation. Every actual dyadic multiplication pointmap is surjective. Actual F5 y2=x3+x doubles every rational point tozero; actual nonzero point(0,0) has nohalf, explicitly refuting the unguarded rational-points reading. Closedfield2/3/0 controls. Point surjectivity distinct from functionfield surjectivity; no full Scheme/general[n]/larger pairing closure, signedunverified/zero spend.
